permissions.name: uml-viewer.process
permissions.reason: Run the native IR generator and quality tools through the session sandbox policy and DSH subprocess provider.

permissions.name: uml-viewer.read
permissions.reason: Read policy and source files in the session project and locate the plugin binary.

permissions.name: uml-viewer.write
permissions.reason: Generate project IR and quality snapshots under the session sandbox policy.

permissions.name: uml-viewer.home
permissions.reason: Copy the packaged executable into the plugin's version directory and persist per-session viewer state under DSH_HOME/dsh-uml-viewer only.

x-components.notes: Host and Web client panel with IR, the three quality tools and display. Four optional platform packages provide the executable; unsupported platform/architecture combinations refuse activation with a reason. The browser half is declared in package.json dsh.client and the ./client export (dsh-std 0.15 has no client facet key). Runtime compatibility is package.json engines.dsh.
